title: Canonical coordinates for exponent transport of integration
statement: For the finite constant coefficient module categories and root-normalized Tate lines of [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates], define the shifted root transition, its ordered tensor powers and bundle pullbacks. Define the projective decomposition square and the conjunction of this square with its inverse and second-projection equations. Define the affine and vector trace-transition equations. For a positive modulus killing a finite coefficient ring, define IntegrationTransposeData: the TensorCompatibilityData of [def-pur-vector-tensor-site-equations], the bounded ordinary exceptional object, the ordinary adjunct isomorphism, the comparison-unit rho isomorphism, and their pro-etale composite with all stated formulas. IntegrationTensorTransitionEquations requires compatible such witnesses at two moduli and the actual integration, transpose and inverse transitions. The full conclusion specializes these predicates to a finite-type scheme over the field in [def-pur-conventions]. All coordinates and predicates are the verbatim original definitions of the parent node, reexported from a common module; only the forward-square predicate is new.
